# foment

> Incite, instigate, stir up, promote the growth of; apply medicated liquid to a body part

> incite or cause troublesome acts; encourage


## Example

- *After having his pay cut, Phil spread vicious rumors about his boss, hoping to foment a general feeling of discontent.*
